mina: quick sync: incoming models are showing bench vs canary mismatch. bench p95 ~60ms, canary p95 intermittently 400ms. this is for short-turn prompts.
hammad: do we have a reproducible microtrace? thinking cache churn or a kernel fallback on certain tokenseqs.
jess: i replayed one trace and saw a `kv_miss` spike + fallback to int8-kernel on one host. also some disk reads at 2.1s. weird.
lena: couple ideas: (1) make probes explicit about target cache state (cold/warmed/primed) (2) record kernel_variant and cpu_backpressure in each probe metadata (3) map bench traces to canary windows instead of blind sampling.
mina: +1. proposal: prober emits compact JSONL lines: `{trace_id, seq_len, cache_hint, kernel_hint, probe_tag}`. stitcher consumes those and produces a canary plan (which nodes, when, reset_kv flag).
hammad: small API sketch: `POST /probes` -> returns `probe_ack` with id. `GET /stitch/{model}` -> returns schedule entries like `{start_ts, node_selector, reset_kv}`. keep it REST to integrate with ci.
jess: important: add `replay_seed` so bench can reproduce ordering for batching. also `prefetch=true` option to pre-prime caches for warm path measurements.
lena: operational constraints: respect pool budget. add `budget_token` field and global throttler. if schedule would exceed dedicated pool quota, stitcher should degrade to shared or skip.
mina: decision points for RFC: - stateless prober vs stateful agent: prefer stateless (simple push, JSONL sink) - stitcher centralized with policy engine - thresholds: per-model-class stored in registry (warn at 1.5x p95, block at 2.5x p95) - runbook: auto-reduce probe rate and notify SRE on >1% errors for 10m.
hammad: caveat: dedicated pools do KV priming which changes cold metrics. we need explicit `reset_kv=true` probes to measure true cold. add that to the probe schema.
jess: logging: include `node_trace` link for full runtime trace and `bench_link` for the original bench microtrace. that helps triage.
lena: alerting: prefer a metric-based signal `probe.runtime_divergence{model,probe_tag}` emitted by stitcher when live p95/p50 ratio > threshold. runbook should include rollback to previous model and hold rollout.
ops-bot: created ticket ML-7834 "canary probe mapping + stitcher RFC" and scheduled RFC review for Thu 10:00am UTC.
mina: action items: mina write RFC draft (schema + API + thresholds), hammad prototype proto-POST that emits sample JSONL, jess add bench replayer prefetch flag, lena define quota policy. will regroup after RFC.
mina: thanks all :raised_hands:
